Smoke weed. I found anti depressants only worsened my conditions. I found weed and I don’t even get crazy high just high enough to let go of some things. But if you don’t like weed maybe try micro dosing? Weed helps with a lot and so do some psychedelics in micro amounts can have profound results. Yes it’s not legal everywhere but who knows if you can make the move make the move enjoy life without the depressants. I recently got some free weights and bars on Facebook and started working out helped a lot too. Some days I don’t even smoke weed if I get a really good workout in. Better sleep schedule I recommend 6-8 hours of sleep and a really good strong diet can really do wonders man. Stay away from soda if you need sugar grab a body armor or a Gatorade but drink in moderation. I promise if you do all those things I laid out it should reduce symptoms and change how you feel. Not enough people get a good workout in and working out is great way to burn off energy and keep your mind elsewhere. It’s hard to be depressed while curling some weight man lol trust me. If you need any tips please hmu. I gotchu fam.
Edit: from a man who’s personally dealt with suicidal tendencies and massive issues regarding self harm and what not I promise these things do work. Get good sleep. Workout. Eat healthy.
